claim: The 33.9% Finance and Insurance any-AI rate proves agentic chart-review has crossed the 16% chasm and is irreversible.
source_fact: S2 supplies the 33.9% broad any-AI measure for the period ending 2026-05-03, not a chart-review denominator.
why: Technology, use definition, relevant peer population and current date do not match. Rogers category shares and the course chasm heuristic are not a statistical test.
replacement: Broad AI exposure is visible in US finance, but comparable chart-review deployment and repeat-use data are needed to identify this application’s diffusion stage.
discriminating_evidence: Dated peer sample with a defined chart-review system, geography, denominator, experimentation versus sustained scaling, and repeated outcomes.
